newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 opens firm, chartists predict 5,000.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 opens firm, chartists predict 5,000.

text.p: Britain's leading share index powered higher at Thursday's open and was on track to top the 5,000-point level, boosted by record closing highs in London and New York and early strength in financial stocks, dealers said.
At 0749 GMT, the FTSE 100 traded 27.6 points higher at 4,991.8, matching its all-time best hit on Wednesday.
Technical analysts predicted a move to above 5,000, with minor resistance following at 5,020.
